description: How the person's own visit is going, from the link in their check-in text (https://app.nextupwalkin.com/w/…) or on their status page (https://app.nextupwalkin.com/q/…?t=…): whether they are still waiting, how many people are ahead of them, about how many minutes (only where the place works minutes out; otherwise give the count), and whether and when they were called. Use it when the person who checked in asks how much longer, what number they are or whether they've been called, and gives or pastes that link. The link is private to that person: never ask for anyone else's, and don't repeat it or its `t` code back. It returns nothing personal (no names, phone numbers or notes) and changes nothing. Estimates, not a promise: say "about". If the link doesn't work it says so.

link.description: The status link from the person's check-in text or page, like https://app.nextupwalkin.com/q/…?t=…
